title: The Falling Upward
text: The ground lets go of you. Slowly, gently, the party begins to fall upward, boots leaving the earth and packs floating, toward a sky made of other ground, with fields and roads hanging upside down far above. Your stomach does not like it at all.

options.label: Swim through the air toward the far ground, and try not to look down. Or up.

outcomes.text: You land on the far side a long way on, retching.
You land somewhere else, upside down. Something there was expecting you.

options.label: The strongest grabs a rock and holds everyone on, until the world remembers itself.

outcomes.text: The world settles back down. Their arms do not, for a long while.

options.label: Let go, and fall upward, and see where the sky takes you.

outcomes.text: You fall up and over, then down again. Everyone lands shaking, though somehow wiser.
